kpis.sub: ILLUMINA (ILMN) EDGES UP TO $269 INTO OCT 29 Q3; STEPHENS DOWNGRADES, CANACCORD LIFTS TARGET TO $300
kpis.label: ILMN closed at $269.42 on Oct 23 (flat on the day; $262.54 a week earlier), market cap $40.68B, about 50x trailing earnings. The 21-analyst average target is $248.90 (about 8% below price). Stephens cut to Equal Weight (target $275), Evercore dropped it from its Core Ideas list, and Canaccord raised to $300 (Buy). BioInsight software, including DRAGEN Ultra, went to early access (~Oct 20). Q3 results are due Oct 29 after the close.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI (TEM) +6% ON OCT 23 TO $67.62 AFTER BMS DATA-LICENSING EXPANSION; Q3 RESULTS NOV 2
kpis.label: TEM closed at $67.62 on Oct 23 (+5.96% on the day; $64.72 a week earlier), market cap $12.20B, with a $74.94 consensus target (20 analysts, Buy). TTM revenue is $1.43B (+50%) against a net loss near $254M. Tempus expanded its Bristol Myers Squibb collaboration (~Oct 22) to include multimodal oncology data licensing through 2031, and presented NSCLC pre-screening panel data with over 80% sensitivity (~Oct 18).

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week beyond Bloomberg's Oct 8 report of preliminary talks at a valuation of at least $40B (possibly up to $50B) versus about $17.5B previously; no deal is final. It closed a $2.1B Series B in May 2026 and still targets first trials by year-end 2026 for ISM8969. Alphabet ownership makes a near-term IPO unlikely.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Rentosertib's Phase III (GENESIS-IPF) remains underway with a realistic approval window of 2029-2030 per the lead investigator's own estimate — years, not quarters, from here. Still the only name in this group already public (HKEX, Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. The company continues hiring out its business-development function to line up partnerships that supply preclinical disease-area data rather than capital — it says the $1.3B already raised covers its near-term needs — but no partner has been named and no trial has started.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Still the year's largest single disclosed longevity round (~71% of 2026's disclosed longevity funding through August); its first candidate medicine remains in large-scale manufacturing with clinical entry targeted as early as 2027.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic — and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Insilico's lead investigator puts rentosertib's realistic approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's BLA (PDUFA Mar 10, 2027) is gene editing, not AI discovery; Barclays is Underweight ($8) on commercial headwinds and NTLA sits at $11.21.

bear_case.title: Platform partnerships are financed by dilution
bear_case.description: Recursion raised $200M at $3.25 (Oct 15) the same day Sanofi opted in to a candidate, and has rebounded only to $3.70. Relay raised $275M at $12 in May. Generate ($12.41 vs $16 IPO) and Eikon (~$8.17 vs $18) show how IPO-window names fade without an approved drug.

bear_case.title: Illumina and Tempus price ahead of fundamentals
bear_case.description: ILMN ($269.42) is about 8% above its $248.90 average target at ~50x earnings; Stephens downgraded and Evercore dropped it from Core Ideas this week, with Q3 on Oct 29. TEM ($67.62) is still loss-making (net loss ~$254M TTM) and just had a 9% one-day drop and a 6% one-day rebound in successive weeks; Q3 is Nov 2.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and sub-scale proteomics
bear_case.description: Guardant's PTAB challenge to a core TwinStrand patent was rejected (~Oct 14) and the federal judgment appeal is open. Quantum-Si ($1.40 after a 21.7% one-day jump) has TTM revenue of $1.61M (-53%), a $306M market cap and a launch not until Q2 2027 — Proteus detects 19 amino acids, not yet a product.

bear_case.title: Rebounds are fragile: the sector is still volatile and rate-sensitive
bear_case.description: XBI closed $149.54 on Oct 23 (-1.4% on the day; 52-week range $106.30-$169.89; 1-year gain ~39.9%) after a -3.7% day the prior Friday. Rallies this extended reverse on a hawkish rates move or failed readout; the PhRMA lawsuit against the administration (Oct 7) adds policy noise.
